from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import cv2
from PIL import Image
from artifact_io import save

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'), dtype=np.uint8)
H,W = BASE.shape[:2]
YY,XX = np.mgrid[:H,:W]

# Scene geometry inferred from the supplied frame: dispenser liquid occupies x=134..172,
# its tap/spout is to the right, and the receiving tumbler is centered near x=202.
# Only the changing liquid is synthesized; the locked-off photographed scene stays intact.
def alpha_over(im, color, alpha):
    a=np.clip(alpha,0,1)[...,None]
    return np.clip(im.astype(np.float32)*(1-a)+np.asarray(color,np.float32)*a,0,255).astype(np.uint8)

def soft_mask(mask, sigma=.7):
    return cv2.GaussianBlur(mask.astype(np.float32),(0,0),sigmaX=sigma,sigmaY=sigma)

def frame_at(k):
    if k==0: return BASE.copy()
    im=BASE.copy()
    # Valve opens rapidly after the initial instant. The coherent stream starts beneath
    # the existing spigot at (181,76), arcs slightly right, and enters the glass at y~91.
    flow=np.clip((k-0.35)/2.0,0,1)
    shut=np.clip((19.7-k)/2.2,0,1)
    strength=flow*shut
    # Red liquid accumulating in the transparent glass. Approximate visible inner bowl
    # (elliptical tumbler, narrowing gently toward its bottom at y=123).
    level=123.0-min(k,17)/17.0*28.0
    half=np.maximum(10.5, 17.7-0.125*(YY-91))
    inside=(YY>=level)&(YY<=123)&(np.abs(XX-202)<=half)
    # meniscus-aware ruby liquid, with dark lower absorption and inherited glass texture
    depth=np.clip((YY-level)/31,0,1)
    col=np.zeros_like(im,dtype=np.float32)
    col[...,0]=178-25*depth; col[...,1]=31-8*depth; col[...,2]=29-5*depth
    # lighting from right and a muted vertical glass highlight
    col[...,0]+=15*np.clip((XX-194)/22,0,1)
    liquid_a=soft_mask(inside,.48)*(.67+.13*depth)
    im=alpha_over(im,col,liquid_a)
    # Dark saturated curved meniscus and a narrow specular glint.
    men=((np.abs((YY-level)-0.10*((XX-202)/17)**2)<0.62)&(np.abs(XX-202)<half))
    im=alpha_over(im,(125,18,20),soft_mask(men,.45)*.48)
    glint=inside&(XX>=207)&(XX<=209)&(YY>level+3)&(YY<120)
    im=alpha_over(im,(241,100,79),soft_mask(glint,.45)*.22)

    # Main falling stream, slightly sinuous and bright-edged. Hide its part already under
    # the rising liquid surface. Real-time oscillation is subpixel and deterministic.
    end=min(level+1,95.0)
    active=(YY>=77)&(YY<=end)
    center=181.5 + .17*(YY-77) + .28*np.sin(k*1.31+(YY-77)*.30)
    radius=1.75 + .18*np.sin(k*.83)
    d=np.abs(XX-center)
    stream=active & (d<=radius)
    # darker center, translucent antialiased border, highlight on left
    sa=soft_mask(stream,.42)*strength*.92
    scol=np.zeros_like(im,dtype=np.float32)
    scol[...,0]=218; scol[...,1]=35; scol[...,2]=32
    scol[...,0]+=21*np.exp(-((XX-(center-.75))/.55)**2)
    scol[...,1]+=13*np.exp(-((XX-(center-.75))/.55)**2)
    im=alpha_over(im,scol,sa)
    core=active&(d<.55)
    im=alpha_over(im,(153,17,22),soft_mask(core,.34)*strength*.34)

    # Compact impact crown/ripples where stream meets the surface; restrained to preserve realism.
    if strength>.15 and level<121:
        iy=int(round(level))
        phase=k*.9
        ring=np.abs(np.sqrt(((XX-184.3)/1.45)**2+((YY-iy)/.58)**2)-(2.0+.25*np.sin(phase)))<.48
        ring &= (np.abs(XX-184)<8)&(np.abs(YY-iy)<3)
        im=alpha_over(im,(230,53,44),soft_mask(ring,.45)*strength*.45)
        # one or two tiny upward droplets during established flow
        if 4<=k<=15:
            for j in range(2):
                dx=(-1 if j==0 else 1)*(2.3+j*.8)
                cy=iy-2.1-(1.1 if ((k+j)%4==0) else 0)
                drop=((XX-(184+dx))**2/(.75**2)+(YY-cy)**2/(1.05**2))<1
                im=alpha_over(im,(225,48,38),soft_mask(drop,.38)*strength*.64)
    return im

frames=np.stack([frame_at(i) for i in range(20)]).astype(np.uint8)
assert np.array_equal(frames[0],BASE)
save(frames, ROOT)

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import cv2
from PIL import Image
from artifact_io import save

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'), dtype=np.uint8)
H,W = BASE.shape[:2]
YY,XX = np.mgrid[:H,:W]

# Scene geometry inferred from the supplied frame: dispenser liquid occupies x=134..172,
# its tap/spout is to the right, and the receiving tumbler is centered near x=202.
# Only the changing liquid is synthesized; the locked-off photographed scene stays intact.
def alpha_over(im, color, alpha):
    a=np.clip(alpha,0,1)[...,None]
    return np.clip(im.astype(np.float32)*(1-a)+np.asarray(color,np.float32)*a,0,255).astype(np.uint8)

def soft_mask(mask, sigma=.7):
    return cv2.GaussianBlur(mask.astype(np.float32),(0,0),sigmaX=sigma,sigmaY=sigma)

def frame_at(k):
    if k==0: return BASE.copy()
    im=BASE.copy()
    # Valve opens rapidly after the initial instant. The coherent stream starts beneath
    # the existing spigot at (181,76), arcs slightly right, and enters the glass at y~91.
    flow=np.clip((k-0.35)/2.0,0,1)
    shut=np.clip((19.7-k)/2.2,0,1)
    strength=flow*shut
    # Red liquid accumulating in the transparent glass. Approximate visible inner bowl
    # (elliptical tumbler, narrowing gently toward its bottom at y=123).
    level=123.0-min(k,17)/17.0*28.0
    half=np.maximum(10.5, 17.7-0.125*(YY-91))
    inside=(YY>=level)&(YY<=123)&(np.abs(XX-202)<=half)
    # meniscus-aware ruby liquid, with dark lower absorption and inherited glass texture
    depth=np.clip((YY-level)/31,0,1)
    col=np.zeros_like(im,dtype=np.float32)
    col[...,0]=178-25*depth; col[...,1]=31-8*depth; col[...,2]=29-5*depth
    # lighting from right and a muted vertical glass highlight
    col[...,0]+=15*np.clip((XX-194)/22,0,1)
    liquid_a=soft_mask(inside,.48)*(.67+.13*depth)
    im=alpha_over(im,col,liquid_a)
    # Dark saturated curved meniscus and a narrow specular glint.
    men=((np.abs((YY-level)-0.10*((XX-202)/17)**2)<0.62)&(np.abs(XX-202)<half))
    im=alpha_over(im,(125,18,20),soft_mask(men,.45)*.48)
    glint=inside&(XX>=207)&(XX<=209)&(YY>level+3)&(YY<120)
    im=alpha_over(im,(241,100,79),soft_mask(glint,.45)*.22)

    # Main falling stream, slightly sinuous and bright-edged. Hide its part already under
    # the rising liquid surface. Real-time oscillation is subpixel and deterministic.
    end=min(level+1,95.0)
    active=(YY>=77)&(YY<=end)
    center=181.5 + .17*(YY-77) + .28*np.sin(k*1.31+(YY-77)*.30)
    radius=1.75 + .18*np.sin(k*.83)
    d=np.abs(XX-center)
    stream=active & (d<=radius)
    # darker center, translucent antialiased border, highlight on left
    sa=soft_mask(stream,.42)*strength*.92
    scol=np.zeros_like(im,dtype=np.float32)
    scol[...,0]=218; scol[...,1]=35; scol[...,2]=32
    scol[...,0]+=21*np.exp(-((XX-(center-.75))/.55)**2)
    scol[...,1]+=13*np.exp(-((XX-(center-.75))/.55)**2)
    im=alpha_over(im,scol,sa)
    core=active&(d<.55)
    im=alpha_over(im,(153,17,22),soft_mask(core,.34)*strength*.34)

    # Compact impact crown/ripples where stream meets the surface; restrained to preserve realism.
    if strength>.15 and level<121:
        iy=int(round(level))
        phase=k*.9
        ring=np.abs(np.sqrt(((XX-184.3)/1.45)**2+((YY-iy)/.58)**2)-(2.0+.25*np.sin(phase)))<.48
        ring &= (np.abs(XX-184)<8)&(np.abs(YY-iy)<3)
        im=alpha_over(im,(230,53,44),soft_mask(ring,.45)*strength*.45)
        # one or two tiny upward droplets during established flow
        if 4<=k<=15:
            for j in range(2):
                dx=(-1 if j==0 else 1)*(2.3+j*.8)
                cy=iy-2.1-(1.1 if ((k+j)%4==0) else 0)
                drop=((XX-(184+dx))**2/(.75**2)+(YY-cy)**2/(1.05**2))<1
                im=alpha_over(im,(225,48,38),soft_mask(drop,.38)*strength*.64)
    return im

frames=np.stack([frame_at(i) for i in range(20)]).astype(np.uint8)
assert np.array_equal(frames[0],BASE)
save(frames, ROOT)
